title: HSK1 Gate 22 · Republic of China
explanationEn: Gate 22: Republic of China. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第22关：民国。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 一百多年以前，中国还有皇帝，可是那时候的日子很不好过。很多人想：中国要不一样。有一个人叫孙中山，他年轻的时候学过医，会给人看病。他去过很多国家，看到别的国家没有皇帝也很好。
passageEn: A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor, but life in those days was very hard. Many people thought: China must be different. There was a man called Sun Yat-sen, who had studied medicine as a young man and could treat the sick. He had been to many countries, and saw that other countries did well without an emperor.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor, but life in those days was very hard.
comprehension.answer: 一百多年以前，中国还有皇帝，可是那时候的日子很不好过。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: There was a man called Sun Yat-sen, who had studied medicine as a young man and could treat the sick.
comprehension.answer: 有一个人叫孙中山，他年轻的时候学过医，会给人看病。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.explanation: “多”（duō）的意思是“more than”，就在上面的短文里。

options.text: A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor, but life in those days was very hard.
Long ago, a great flood came to China.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.

check.explanationEn: "一百多年以前，中国还有皇帝，可是那时候的日子很不好过。" means "A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor, but life in those days was very hard.".
